limits: All cases are synthetic and authored with this implementation. Reserved families are not an independent blind evaluation.
Each latency sample is one method call per case with allocation tracing enabled. No repeated-run interval is estimated.
The fixture census does not estimate production error rates or policy improvement.
The dense categorical assertion is the strongest simple baseline. Detection parity is not an Avalon advantage.
No model, trainer, GPU, or external API executes. Local electricity cost is not measured.
sampling.memory_scope: The whole benchmark uses tracemalloc. Existing tracing yields no attributed memory measurement.

limits: Expected labels come from hand-authored mutations and missing-evidence controls, not the tested verifier.
The simple assertion is specific to this fixture contract. The suite does not establish a detection advantage or population accuracy.
Latency excludes fixture construction. RSS samples are not peak-memory measurements. Local compute costs are unmeasured.
The runner contains no model API client. It makes zero API calls and incurs zero API fees by construction.
No policy training runs in this benchmark.

latency.uncertainty: Observed local samples include clock overhead. No latency confidence interval is estimated.

results.uncertainty: Exact counts for this finite synthetic suite. Repetitions do not increase the accuracy sample size.
